account_enumeration.description: The published advisory documents an account-enumeration response discrepancy in SCRAM authentication: the challenge for an existing username with non-default settings can differ from the challenge for a nonexistent username, allowing remote testing of registered user/account existence by username.
account_enumeration.selection_basis: fresh reviewed advisory selected before scoring using the preregistered account-enumeration semantic audit
account_enumeration.summary: PostgreSQL SCRAM authentication response behavior can let an unauthenticated caller determine whether a username/account exists.

authentication_session.description: The advisory describes improper validation in an NTLM authentication/session negotiation path that can let a remote actor bypass the intended authentication boundary and obtain an authenticated session context with another user's effective privileges.
authentication_session.selection_basis: fresh published advisory selected before scoring using the preregistered authentication/session semantic audit
authentication_session.summary: IBM i improper authentication during NTLM session negotiation can allow authentication bypass and session impersonation.

broken_function_authorization.description: The project security issue documents function-level authorization missing from administrative controllers. A low-privilege authenticated user could access privileged admin mutations and rewrite roles, policies or grants because generic authentication was enforced without the required admin/manage permission check.
broken_function_authorization.selection_basis: fresh project security issue selected before scoring using the preregistered function-level authorization semantic audit
broken_function_authorization.summary: Andy RBAC management functions had a critical authorization bypass allowing authenticated non-admin tokens to invoke privileged role, policy and grant administration.

command_injection.description: The published advisory states that improper sanitization of untrusted SMTP input in the SNMP notification path can execute arbitrary operating-system commands as the Zimbra process user. Untrusted input therefore reaches an OS command/process execution boundary.
command_injection.selection_basis: fresh published advisory selected before scoring using the preregistered command-injection semantic audit
command_injection.summary: Zimbra Collaboration contains OS command injection in SNMP notification processing.

cryptographic_failure.description: The project security issue documents insecure and predictable session-secret values being accepted in production despite a documented entropy/length requirement. The cryptographic secret validation gate therefore permits weak key material instead of rejecting insecure production secrets.
cryptographic_failure.selection_basis: fresh project security issue selected before scoring using the preregistered cryptographic-failure semantic audit
cryptographic_failure.summary: Hedron's production security gate accepted weak cryptographic session secrets such as predictable low-entropy values.

exceptional_condition_mishandling.description: The project owner documents that an unhandled exception reaches Textual fatal-error rendering with frame locals enabled. The application exits/crashes while printing sensitive plaintext from live local variables to terminal/log output instead of handling the exceptional condition through the controlled exception-only path.
exceptional_condition_mishandling.selection_basis: fresh owner-authored issue selected before scoring using the preregistered exceptional-condition semantic audit
exceptional_condition_mishandling.summary: time-safe mishandles an unhandled exception by rendering a locals-bearing fatal traceback on the crash path, disclosing plaintext secrets.

file_upload.description: The published advisory states that the upload extension filter is empty and authentication is disabled by default, so a remote attacker can upload an arbitrary PHP webshell with a dangerous filename/extension and subsequently execute the uploaded file.
file_upload.selection_basis: fresh published advisory selected before scoring using the preregistered file-upload semantic audit
file_upload.summary: phpfm has an unrestricted file-upload vulnerability allowing unauthenticated arbitrary PHP-file upload.

mass_assignment.description: The project security issue describes a classic mass-assignment/over-posting pattern: create/update request schemas expose a server-authoritative property and PUT mass-assigns the client-supplied s3_url field, allowing a tenant to influence a protected property and cross an object-ownership boundary.
mass_assignment.selection_basis: fresh project security issue selected before scoring using the preregistered mass-assignment semantic audit
mass_assignment.summary: Narrative Modeling App mass assignment lets a tenant set the server-authoritative s3_url property.

race_condition.description: The vendor advisory states that a locally authenticated non-administrative Windows user can escalate privileges to NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM, but successful exploitation requires winning a race condition. The vendor identifies the affected and fixed GlobalProtect App for Windows versions.
race_condition.selection_basis: fresh primary vendor advisory selected before scoring using the preregistered race-condition semantic audit after the previous GHSA reference proved non-retrievable
race_condition.summary: Palo Alto Networks GlobalProtect App on Windows allows local privilege escalation where exploitation requires successfully winning a race condition.

secret_exposure.description: The published advisory states that a hardcoded authentication token is present in the application source code and reused for inter-node and REST API authentication, exposing a reusable credential/secret through the software source.
secret_exposure.selection_basis: fresh published advisory selected before scoring using the preregistered secret-exposure semantic audit
secret_exposure.summary: IBM Storage Scale GUI contains a hardcoded token in source code used for cluster communication and REST API authentication.

security_logging_alerting_failure.description: The published advisory states that local attackers can obtain sensitive information because plain text passwords are logged in Db2 trace files. The logging path therefore records credential data without redaction.
security_logging_alerting_failure.selection_basis: fresh published advisory selected before scoring using the preregistered security-logging semantic audit
security_logging_alerting_failure.summary: IBM Db2 logging can write sensitive plaintext passwords into trace files.

server_side_template_injection.description: A project-member audit issue documents non-superadmin-controlled Twig template source reaching the server-side Twig Environment without SandboxExtension. Injected Twig expressions are rendered by the full template engine and can read secrets, invoke registered hooks and potentially reach code execution through plugin functions.
server_side_template_injection.selection_basis: fresh project-member security audit issue selected before scoring using the preregistered SSTI semantic audit
server_side_template_injection.summary: OwnPay security audit found full server-side template injection in TwigFactory because editable templates render with the full unsandboxed Twig environment.

unrestricted_resource_consumption.description: The published CWE-400 advisory identifies remote denial of service through monitored-item event-queue resizing. Attacker-controlled queue changes can consume application resources until service availability is lost, representing an unbounded resource-consumption path.
unrestricted_resource_consumption.selection_basis: fresh published advisory selected before scoring using the preregistered resource-consumption semantic audit
unrestricted_resource_consumption.summary: S2OPC contains uncontrolled resource consumption in monitored-item queue resize handling that can cause remote denial of service.
